description: Latest CMS NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) per-unit prices for a drug name, brand name or NDC, from data.medicaid.gov (monthly pharmacy invoice survey, weekly files). Groups by NADAC description, pricing unit (EA, ML, GM), generic or brand rate class and OTC flag, each with min, median and max unit cost across NDCs, effective date, NDC count, sample NDCs, and a 30-unit acquisition cost for per-dose EA items. Single-source generics map to RxNorm brand names. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

q.description: Drug name, brand name or NDC, optionally with strength (e.g. metformin, Lipitor 20 mg, 00003-0894-21)

strength.description: Strength filter text matched against NADAC descriptions, e.g. 20 MG, 500 MG/5 ML, 100 UNIT/ML

name: rx_price
title: Drug acquisition cost (CMS NADAC)
